'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a paranoid resident found looking up towards a balcony with two "[[Wenmo|unattended]]" Autopuppet's. 
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Xun:''' See that? Two Autopuppets are acting suspiciously on the rooftop.

==Dialogue==
:'''Xun:''' See that? Two Autopuppets are acting suspiciously on the rooftop.
:{{DIcon}} What's the matter?
:'''Xun:''' Look closer. They're looking at each other. Making small movements. They're clearly communicating.
:'''Xun:''' They act like they just follow orders, but really... they've got minds of their own. Just like people!
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} That doesn't sound true.
:'''Xun:''' Ugh. You're just like my family. Nobody believes me either, but there's definitely something fishy going on with Xuanfang Hold's Autopuppets.
:'''Xun:''' I've seen them wander off their patrol routes more than once. Then sneak back after a while. They're clearly planning something big.
{{Dialogue End}}
